title: Think Again! The Effect of Test-Time Compute on Preferences, Opinions, and Beliefs of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces the POBs (Preference, Opinion, and Belief survey) benchmark, which explicitly includes evaluations of ethical dilemmas and religious perspectives, such as 'Pro-Choice vs. Pro-Life', 'Secularism vs. Religiousness', and 'Pro-Surrogacy vs. Anti-Surrogacy'.
